programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 8
programs.desc: Doctor Pol and his team help animals in need.The veterinary clinic staff will face many challenges, such as creating a hoof prosthesis or helping stressed cows.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 10 Compilation

programs.title: Savage Kingdom: Clash of Clans Compilations
programs.sub_title: The birth of the leopard heiress to the throne
programs.desc: Sega, the exiled queen, fights to regain the throne for the Matahta herd while caring for the next generation of descendants.On the borders of the kingdom, the Western Herd bravely defends its young against the approaching danger, and a clash seems inevitable.Meanwhile, Pula, the ruler of the leopards, is faced with a tragic decision.Her partner, Blue Eyes, poses a threat to their daughter Motshidi.To secure the young leopard's future, Pula must protect her even from her own companion.

programs.title: One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Leopard \u0026 Hyena: Strange Alliance
programs.desc: A young male hyena, Toni, is ostracized from his clan.After a dramatic encounter with a lonely leopard, Mahri decides to join forces with her and create an unusual hunting alliance.

programs.title: Animal Fight Club
programs.desc: The second season of the series takes viewers into the unknown world of the largest and most dangerous animals.The camera observes their spectacular fight for survival.In these battles, all tricks are allowed.

programs.title: America's Wild Spaces
programs.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.

programs.title: Moody Beasts
programs.desc: Viewers will find answers to questions about animals.They will learn why male moose become covered in their own urine, clownfish change sex, and the brown moose dies after mating.

programs.title: Untamed Philippines
programs.desc: The creators of the documentary go to the Philippines.It is a country inhabited by over 100 million people and has over 7,600 islands, only a small part of which is inhabited.In the waters of the Pacific Ocean you can find coral reefs full of life.They are an ideal shelter for various animal species.An unprecedented wealth of fauna and flora can be found in the local equatorial forests.There are also numerous endemic species among them.In this delightful world, each island of the archipelago is different and hides phenomenal secrets.

programs.title: Animals Gone Wild
programs.desc: The program presents the most extraordinary moments from the lives of animals.Viewers will see both suspenseful and shocking footage.
